title: What gives a scam video away?
instruction: In your feed there is a video of a celebrity giving money away. Mark the warning signs.
debrief: A lifelike voice and lots of likes prove nothing; deepfakes can do those too. What warns you is money, hurry and the fact that the video isn’t on the official account.

items.text: It wants you to send money first
items.why: Someone who gives things away doesn’t want anything first.

items.text: It isn’t on that person’s official account
items.why: A real offer would be there.

items.text: It pushes you to hurry: today only
items.why: The hurry is meant to stop you from checking.

items.text: The voice sounds exactly like that person
items.why: A cloned voice sounds exactly right too.

items.text: The video has thousands of likes
items.why: Likes can be bought, and scams spread even without them.

items.text: It promises to double your money
